items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: He's, he's the fellow that sent for the, that's Louis Armstrong. That'd be Joe Oliver.

ctx.x: One-eyed buck. You mean bad-eyed Joe? Joe? He's, he's the fellow that sent for the, that's Louis Armstrong. That'd be Joe Oliver.
Joe Oliver, that's his name. Yeah, yeah. One-eyed buck. One-eyed buck. I never heard a guy. I heard a bad-eyed Joe, but never one. One-eyed buck. Mm- dear

items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: See that beat that Lewis has got? Same kind of beat. Lewis Armstrong.

ctx.x: In the old days they usually play more slower.

We played, no, we played sort of swing music, you know what I mean? For a time music, you know what I mean? For people to dance. You know and if somebody would say well play us a fast number, we kind of play a little fast. But the majority of the music was a, you know sort of a nice beat. See that beat that Lewis has got? Same kind of beat. Lewis Armstrong. That kind of a beat. Full rhythm time, you see what I mean? If you're going to do it, you know, don't sound good. No. No, and there ain't got time to make it…
ago. Jefferson, Thomas Jefferson. Thomas Jefferson. He's back again now.
